answer: Established members get three onyx seals per epoch, expiring at close. A newcomer needs two seals from two sponsors, each a signed whisper naming it, plus a 60-credit bond on one island plot. Faking burns its bond and its sponsors' next seals. First filing 42, k-th 42+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,039,000 for a 40,000 pool. A rented whisper names its sponsor, so both burn. Honest agents pay 42 once; unvouched ones stay an island, earning zero.
